grammar_title: -ing 分词作定语(主动/进行含义)
source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 5 Using language:-ing 分词作定语。前置修饰(a rising sun)/后置修饰短语(= 定语从句,the road leading to town)/-ing 与 -ed 的主动被动对比。句子地道,旅行主题,干扰项为 -ed/不定式/原形,使主动·进行含义的 -ing 唯一成立。

points.point: 前置 -ing(单个分词作定语:a running river)
points.overview: 单个 -ing 分词放在名词前作定语,表主动/正在进行(被修饰名词主动发出该动作):the rising sun = 正在升起的太阳。干扰的 -ed 表被动/完成,在此不成立。

points.point: 后置 -ing 短语(= 定语从句:the road leading to town)
points.overview: -ing 分词带宾语/状语时放在名词后作定语,相当于一个主动的定语从句(the road leading to town = the road that leads to town)。

points.point: -ing 与 -ed 作定语的主动/被动对比
points.overview: 事物使人产生感受时,用 -ing(主动:令人……的);人感到该感受时才用 -ed。an exciting journey = 令人兴奋的旅程(旅程主动让人兴奋)。

questions.stem: Look at the ____ sun over the eastern hills; it is going to be a fine day.
questions.explanation: 太阳主动'正在升起',名词前用 -ing;risen 表完成/被动,在此不成立。

questions.stem: Cars cannot cross the ____ river after two days of heavy rain.
questions.explanation: 河水主动奔流,前置定语用 flowing。

questions.stem: We filled our bottles with cold ____ water from the mountain spring.
questions.explanation: running water 流动的水,水主动流动,用 -ing。

questions.stem: The ____ road up the hill made our drive into the village very slow.
questions.explanation: 蜿蜒的路,路主动'盘绕而上',用 winding;wound 表被动不成立。

questions.stem: We stopped the car to watch the ____ sun turn the sky orange.
questions.explanation: 正在西沉的太阳,主动进行,用 setting。

questions.stem: A ____ number of tourists visit this small island every summer.
questions.explanation: a growing number 不断增长的数量,主动进行,用 -ing。

questions.stem: The ____ wind on the mountain pass made every traveller shiver.
questions.explanation: 刺骨的(正在使人冷的)风,主动用 freezing;frozen 表被冻结,在此不成立。

questions.stem: We could hear ____ dogs as we walked through the quiet village at night.
questions.explanation: 正在吠叫的狗,主动进行,用 barking。

questions.stem: The ____ holiday gave us a perfect chance to plan a long trip.
questions.explanation: 即将到来的假期,主动用 coming(= the holiday that is coming)。

questions.stem: The ____ seasons make this region beautiful all year round.
questions.explanation: 不断变化的季节,主动进行,用 changing;changed 表被改变,不合此意。

questions.stem: From the boat we watched the ____ stars above the calm dark sea.
questions.explanation: 闪耀的星星,星星主动发光,用 shining。

questions.stem: The ____ storm forced the travellers to stay one more night at the inn.
questions.explanation: 正在逼近的风暴,主动进行,用 approaching。

questions.stem: A ____ passenger missed his stop and only woke up at the last station.
questions.explanation: 正在睡觉的乘客,主动进行,用 sleeping。

questions.stem: The ____ passengers on the platform kept looking at their watches.
questions.explanation: 正在等候的乘客,主动进行,用 waiting。

questions.stem: The ____ train left the station exactly on time this morning.
questions.explanation: 正要离站的列车,主动用 departing。

questions.stem: The ____ hills around the lake were covered with thick green trees.
questions.explanation: 周围的群山,山主动'环绕',用 surrounding;hills 本身不被环绕,故不用 surrounded。

questions.stem: We waved at the ____ cars from the side of the country road.
questions.explanation: 经过的车,车主动驶过,用 passing。

questions.stem: We could hear the ____ waves against the rocks all through the night.
questions.explanation: 翻滚的海浪,主动进行,用 rolling。

questions.stem: The ____ engine of the old tour bus made a very loud noise.
questions.explanation: 轰鸣的引擎,主动发声,用 roaring。

questions.stem: Bright ____ lights welcomed us to the small seaside town at night.
questions.explanation: 闪烁的灯,主动闪烁,用 flashing。

questions.stem: The road ____ to the village is very steep and narrow.
questions.explanation: = the road that leads to the village,主动后置定语用 leading。

questions.stem: The man ____ next to the driver is our local guide for the trip.
questions.explanation: = the man who is sitting next to the driver,主动后置用 sitting。

questions.stem: The train ____ from Beijing arrives at the coast around noon.
questions.explanation: = the train that comes from Beijing,主动用 coming。

questions.stem: Tourists ____ photos of the blue lake were smiling happily.
questions.explanation: = tourists who were taking photos,主动用 taking;taken 表被动不成立。

questions.stem: The bus ____ along the coast offers wonderful views of the sea.
questions.explanation: = the bus that runs along the coast,主动用 running。

questions.stem: The river ____ through the green valley is deep and very cold.
questions.explanation: = the river that flows through the valley,主动用 flowing。

questions.stem: The plane ____ to London was delayed for hours by the storm.
questions.explanation: = the plane that was flying to London,主动用 flying;flown 表被动不成立。

questions.stem: The path ____ up the hill is hard to follow when it rains.
questions.explanation: = the path that winds up the hill,主动用 winding。

questions.stem: A sign ____ the way to the museum stood at the street corner.
questions.explanation: = a sign that showed the way,主动用 showing;shown 表被动不成立。

questions.stem: The guide ____ in front of us spoke loudly and very clearly.
questions.explanation: = the guide who was walking in front,主动用 walking。

questions.stem: The family ____ in the car behind us were singing travel songs.
questions.explanation: = the family who were travelling in the car,主动用 travelling。

questions.stem: A couple ____ their heavy luggage hurried past the boarding gate.
questions.explanation: = a couple who were carrying their luggage,主动用 carrying。

questions.stem: The children ____ on the beach built tall castles out of sand.
questions.explanation: = the children who were playing on the beach,主动用 playing。

questions.stem: The ferry ____ the wide river was completely full of cars.
questions.explanation: = the ferry that was crossing the river,主动用 crossing。

questions.stem: The woman ____ the paper map gave us very clear directions.
questions.explanation: = the woman who was holding the map,主动用 holding。

questions.stem: The boat ____ near the shore was full of happy young tourists.
questions.explanation: = the boat that was sailing near the shore,主动用 sailing。

questions.stem: People ____ aboard the ship waved goodbye to their families.
questions.explanation: = people who were going aboard,主动用 going;gone 表被动/完成不成立。

questions.stem: The travellers ____ for the late bus grew more and more impatient.
questions.explanation: = the travellers who were waiting for the bus,主动用 waiting。

questions.stem: The lights ____ in the distance showed us the way back to town.
questions.explanation: = the lights that were shining in the distance,主动用 shining。

questions.stem: A young man ____ a large backpack asked us the way to the station.
questions.explanation: = a young man who was wearing a backpack,主动用 wearing;worn 表被动不成立。

questions.stem: It was the most ____ journey of my whole life, full of surprises.
questions.explanation: 旅程令人兴奋,事物用 -ing;若说人 excited 才用 -ed。

questions.stem: We enjoyed an ____ view of the whole bay from the mountain top.
questions.explanation: 景色令人惊叹,事物主动'使人惊叹',用 amazing。

questions.stem: The night bus to the coast turned out to be a really ____ ride.
questions.explanation: 车程令人疲惫,事物用 tiring;人累才说 tired。

questions.stem: Our guide told us an ____ story about the old fishing harbour.
questions.explanation: 故事有趣,事物用 interesting;人感兴趣才说 interested。

questions.stem: A long ____ delay at the airport ruined the whole morning for us.
questions.explanation: 延误令人恼火,事物用 annoying。

questions.stem: The ____ news about the cancelled flight upset everyone at the gate.
questions.explanation: 消息令人失望,事物用 disappointing。

questions.stem: We had a ____ experience while crossing the wild empty desert.
questions.explanation: 经历令人害怕,事物用 frightening。

questions.stem: From the cliff we saw a truly ____ sight as the sun went down.
questions.explanation: 景象令人惊讶,事物用 surprising。

questions.stem: The ____ scenery along the coast made us stop the car several times.
questions.explanation: 风景迷人,事物主动'使人着迷',用 charming。

questions.stem: Reaching the top after the long climb was a ____ moment for us all.
questions.explanation: 时刻令人满足,事物用 satisfying。

questions.stem: We were given a ____ map that led us the wrong way twice.
questions.explanation: 地图令人困惑,事物用 confusing;人糊涂才说 confused。

questions.stem: The slow local train ride soon became a ____ part of the day.
questions.explanation: 车程令人无聊,事物用 boring;人感到无聊才说 bored。

questions.stem: The sudden storm at sea was a ____ event for the small crew.
questions.explanation: 事件令人震惊,事物用 shocking。

questions.stem: The poor road signs were a ____ problem for every driver there.
questions.explanation: 问题令人担忧,事物用 worrying;人担心才说 worried。

questions.stem: In the end, a safe and happy journey home was a ____ result.
questions.explanation: 结果令人高兴,事物用 pleasing。

questions.stem: The poster on the wall showed an ____ photo of a wild waterfall.
questions.explanation: 照片鼓舞人心,事物用 inspiring。

questions.stem: Climbing the volcano turned out to be an ____ task for the group.
questions.explanation: 任务使人精疲力竭,事物用 exhausting;人累垮才说 exhausted。

questions.stem: The old town was a ____ maze of narrow little streets and steps.
questions.explanation: 迷宫令人费解,事物用 puzzling。

questions.stem: The cool sea breeze gave us a ____ feeling after the long hot drive.
questions.explanation: 感觉清爽提神,事物用 refreshing。

questions.stem: The colourful street festival was an ____ event for all the visitors.
questions.explanation: 活动令人兴奋,事物用 exciting。
